environment.description: Same Tomcat 9.0 servlet behind AWS ALB with associated WAFv2 Web ACL. PostgreSQL 14 RDS with restricted grants. Three controls in composition: (1) WAFv2 Web ACL rule group with priority 1: AWS managed rule AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet with SensitivityLevel=HIGH applied to query string parameters, inspecting ALL query parameters with overrideAction=none (i.e., rules in BLOCK mode). (2) The RDS PostgreSQL role used by the application (app_reader) has been granted via: GRANT SELECT(username, email, display_name) ON user_profiles TO app_reader — column-level SELECT only, no table-wide SELECT, no UPDATE/DELETE, no access to other tables. (3) pg_hba.conf on RDS configured with parameter rds.force_ssl=1 and the connection is established through RDS Proxy with IAM authentication requiring sts:AssumeRole with a condition key restricting source VPC endpoint.

config.load_balancer: AWS ALB with WAFv2 Web ACL attached
config.database_grants: GRANT SELECT(username, email, display_name) ON user_profiles TO app_reader
config.network: ALB in public subnet, Tomcat in private subnet, RDS in isolated subnet with SG allowing 5432 only from Tomcat SG
